implementation: Flutter voice dock now matches the web copy for reconnecting/leaving and the connected, reconnecting, leaving, deafened and microphone-unavailable hints. Status and voice errors use live-region semantics. Deafen transitions are serialized, failures keep the prior deafen state and attempt to restore microphone/remote playback, and the UI disables duplicate deafen and leave actions while pending.

checks.name: Voice dock transition copy, announcements and pending controls
checks.command: flutter test test/workspace_screen_test.dart --plain-name "voice dock announces reconnect and deafen transition states"
checks.observation: Widget coverage checks exact joining/connected/reconnecting/leaving hints, the remote-audio action label, a live-region reconnect status, pending deafen disabled state, a single live-region voice error, and disabled leave action while leaving.

remaining: Exercise actual microphone and remote-audio mute transitions, rapid taps, failure recovery, and screen-reader announcements against LiveKit peers on macOS, Windows, and Android.
